title: Sending Limits: Complete Guide
summary: This document explains Everyone Pay sending limits by account status: New accounts have a $750 daily / $7,500 monthly limit, and Verified accounts have a $3,500 daily / $35,000 monthly limit. It covers how daily and monthly limits work together, where to view remaining availability, and how to request a higher limit (up to 4 days review).
